definitions.explanation: The act of keeping something in good condition or at the same level over time.
To keep something in its existing state.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}を{維持|いじ}することが{大切|たいせつ}です。
examples.english: It's important to maintain your health.

examples.japanese: {秩序|ちつじょ}を{維持|いじ}する。
{維持|いじ}{費|ひ}がかかります。

notes:
{維持|いじ} means to maintain or keep in a certain state.

TRANSITIVITY (as suru verb):
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: Xを{維持|いじ}する (maintain X)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {健康|けんこう}を{維持|いじ}する (maintain health)
- {平和|へいわ}を{維持|いじ}する (maintain peace)
- {水準|すいじゅん}を{維持|いじ}する (maintain standards)
- {維持|いじ}{費|ひ} (maintenance costs)
- {維持|いじ}{管理|かんり} (maintenance and management)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {保|たも}つ: to keep, maintain (native verb)
- {維持|いじ}する: to maintain (Sino-Japanese)
- {保存|ほぞん}する: to preserve (focus on storage)
